title: Analyst, Privacy
description: Headquarters: Remote - USA Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . Coinbase's Privacy team is hiring a Privacy Analyst to own the Privacy Incident Management function, reporting to the Head of Privacy. You'll partner across Privacy, Privacy Legal, Security, Product, Engineering, and Communications to triage incidents involving personal data, drive privacy analysis, coordinate remediation, and continuously improve how Coinbase responds to privacy incidents. This role is built for someone who thrives in ambiguity, drives cross-functional coordination during time-sensitive events, and builds durable process improvements in a fast-moving environment. What you'll do: Own the end-to-end Privacy Incident Management program, including notification workflows, escalation paths, process documentation, responder enablement, and automation opportunities. Lead privacy incident response as the DRI and Incident Commander, coordinating across Privacy, Privacy Legal, CSIRT, Product, Engineering, and Communications to drive analysis, remediation, and follow-through. Maintain on-call readiness to support privacy incident triage, severity classification, and urgent escalations, ensuring incidents are correctly assessed and routed. Drive privacy incident retrospectives, track resulting remediation items and control gaps, and deliver incident metrics and reporting covering trends, remediation status, and process health. Build and maintain strong cross-functional and cross-geography stakeholder relationships to improve readiness, response quality, and business accountability. Support broader Privacy initiatives during lower-volume periods, including cross-functional efforts, tooling development, and automation projects. Required Skills and Experience: 3+ years of experience in privacy, security, incident response, technology risk, or a related operational risk function, including direct experience leading or supporting incident, issue, or risk workflows requiring structured analysis, documentation, and cross-functional coordination. Strong incident management skills with experience communicating privacy risk and incident findings to both technical and non-technical audiences, including producing written incident analyses, retrospective documentation, and executive-level summaries. Proven track record of leading technical investigations within cloud-native architectures, with hands-on proficiency in SQL, Python, and data analysis tools (e.g., Postgres, MongoDB, Airflow, Looker, Snowflake). Demonstrated experience building automation to reduce manual operational tasks and improve incident response efficiency. Working knowledge of privacy regulations and frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, ePrivacy, DPIAs/PIAs, ROPA, data subject rights) data subject rights, privacy controls, and privacy issue management. Utilizes and builds generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. title: Software Engineer - Query Execution
description: Headquarters: Portugal - Remote Be Part of Building the Future Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost. Learn more at www.dremio.com. About the role Dremio’s Query Execution team builds the runtime responsible for executing analytical queries at scale. The team sits between query planning and table scans, building the systems that turn query plans into efficient, reliable execution. As a Software Engineer, you’ll work with experienced engineers to build, test, and support well-scoped improvements to the execution engine. You’ll learn how Dremio’s query runtime works while contributing to areas such as query operators, expression evaluation, memory management, scheduling, and performance. What you’ll be doing Build and support execution-engine components: Implement, test, debug, and maintain well-defined changes to query operators, expression evaluation, execution scheduling, and resource management. Develop reliable software: Write clear, maintainable Java code; add unit and integration tests; and follow established engineering practices for code review, testing, and documentation. Investigate issues: Help diagnose query correctness, reliability, and performance issues using query profiles, logs, telemetry, benchmarks, and production data. Learn runtime and performance fundamentals: Build familiarity with vectorized processing, concurrency, memory usage, parallelism, data exchange, and disk spilling. Collaborate with the team: Work closely with senior engineers and partner teams to understand requirements, break work into manageable tasks, and deliver incremental improvements. Use AI-assisted development tools: Apply AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, and documentation, while validating results through testing, review, and sound engineering judgment. Grow your engineering skills: Participate actively in design discussions and code reviews, seek feedback, and steadily take on broader technical responsibility. What we’re looking for Software engineering foundation: Up to two years of professional software development experience, or equivalent experience through internships, coursework, or substantial personal projects. Programming skills: Proficiency in Java or another object-oriented programming language; willingness to learn and work in a large Java codebase. Computer science fundamentals: Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and basic concurrency concepts. Problem-solving ability: Able to work through well-defined technical problems, ask good questions, and apply feedback to reach a solution. Quality mindset: Commitment to writing tested, maintainable code and learning established development, testing, and review practices. Communication and collaboration: Able to communicate progress, surface blockers early, and work effectively with teammates. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Bonus points if you have Exposure to database internals, query processing, distributed systems, or large-scale data processing. Familiarity with performance-oriented software concepts such as profiling, memory management, concurrency, or vectorized processing. Experience with C++, Apache Arrow, Parquet, Apache Iceberg, Spark, Hadoop, or cloud object stores. Contributions to open-source projects. What we value At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife. title: Lead QA Engineer
description: Headquarters: Remote (US) About the Role As a Lead QA Engineer, you'll own testing strategy and quality standards across our most important work; Deciding what should be automated, what needs a human eye, where the real risk is hiding, and acting on it. You'll work hands-on across both manual and automated testing, splitting your time based on what a given release actually needs, while mentoring other engineers and acting as the go-to voice on quality across projects. You've got the critical thinking skills to chase down a hard bug yourself, know when to ask for help and delegate, and the range to set direction for how the whole team approaches quality. You seek to help your coworkers and do so regularly. Key Responsibilities Lead test strategy and quality standards across multiple projects, deciding what warrants automated coverage versus focused manual and exploratory testing. Build and maintain automated test suites in Playwright, and use BrowserStack to validate compatibility across browsers, devices, and platforms. Define and run deep manual and exploratory testing on new, ambiguous, or high-change-rate work where automation isn't the right investment yet. Translate requirements into concrete test plans and acceptance criteria, catching gaps in the requirements themselves before they become gaps in the product. Act as the technical point of contact for quality with stakeholders: communicate risk, resolve disagreements about scope, and negotiate realistic testing timelines. Write clear, actionable defect reports in Jira, drive them to resolution, and verify fixes actually hold up under retest rather than just passing a second glance. Use Jira's linking and epic structure to keep testing work traceable, and flag workflow friction in the board with the team before it slows down the SDLC. Mentor other QA engineers in both manual technique and automation practice, including how to write tickets clearly and so well that they need no follow-up clarification, raising the bar on testing across the team, not just on your own projects. Step into any project at any phase to assess its quality risk and recommend a concrete path forward. Stay ahead of testing tools and practices worth adopting, and bring the right ones into real workflows deliberately. Operate and champion the use of AI tooling with an understanding that its output is useful, but not infallible. You treat AI as a tool, not a coworker. Craft & Leadership Balance Estimated 60% leadership, 40% craft. Qualifications Required 6-8 years of experience in software quality assurance or testing, ideally with exposure to consulting or multi-stakeholder environments. Strong, hands-on experience with Playwright for building and maintaining automated test suites and frameworks. Experience using BrowserStack (or a comparable cross-browser/device testing platform) to validate compatibility across platforms. Deep grounding in manual, exploratory, and regression testing, with the judgment to know when automation is and isn't the right investment. Proven ability to translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, actionable test plans and acceptance criteria. Strong Jira practice: writing tickets so well that no follow-up or clarification is needed, using issue-linking for traceability, and spotting workflow friction before it becomes a team-wide problem. Experience testing across a range of CMS or SaaS platforms rather than a single stack, since our client environments vary and this role needs to move between them. Exceedingly strong communication skills, including presenting technical risk and testing tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. It cannot be stressed enough how important this item is: communication is the whole ballgame. Prior experience as a technical or testing lead on large or multi-phase projects. Preferred Familiarity with performance testing (e.g. Lighthouse) and accessibility testing (e.g. Axe, WCAG guidelines). Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. Experience with structured test-case formats (e.g. Gherkin) and test case management tooling. A track record of debugging and performance investigation at scale. Creation and implementation of SDLC processes and norms at project and team scales. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact. We’re a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and the Renewals organization to ensure a seamless customer journey and strong renewal outcomes, and you'll coach a bench of first-line managers to build strong, accountable teams. The ideal candidate brings a track record of leading CS leaders (not just CSMs), fluency in both relationship-driven and program/tech-touch models, and a passion for scaling customer outcomes in a high-growth security company. This role reports to the VP of Customer Success. What you will do Lead and develop the Mid Market Customer Success organization, including the people managers of Mid Market and Digital CSMs, coaching them to build and run high-performing teams. Own the strategy and vision for Mid Market Customer Success across both segmented, high-touch coverage and Digital/tech-touch programs, ensuring the two motions are complementary rather than siloed. Own the renewal and expansion outcomes for the Mid Market and Digital segments, partnering closely with the Renewals organization on execution while holding your own managers and CSMs accountable for adoption, health, and expansion pipeline that drives those outcomes. Establish and evolve the segmentation strategy for Mid Market, determining which accounts sit in high-touch CSM coverage versus Digital/automated engagement, and adjusting as the book of business grows. Serve as an escalation point for significant customer issues within Mid Market and Digital, engaging directly with customers when needed and partnering with Product/Engineering to drive resolution. Use data and reporting to monitor customer health, identify retention risk, and guide proactive engagement strategies across both segments. Build and scale success planning frameworks, playbooks, and programs appropriate to Mid Market and Digital customers, distinct from Enterprise motions. Represent the voice of the Mid Market and Digital customer internally, influencing product roadmap and go-to-market priorities for the segment. Travel based on customer and business needs (est. 10–20%). Must Haves 6+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Post-Sales leadership within a B2B SaaS environment, including experience managing people managers. Proven success leading Mid Market or tech-touch/digital customer success motions, ideally in the cybersecurity, email security, or infrastructure SaaS space. Demonstrated ability to run a quota-carrying organization, with ownership of renewal and expansion targets across a segment. Experience building or scaling a segmented CS model. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, adept at engaging stakeholders at all levels internally and externally; multiple languages a plus given the global nature of the segment. Strong leadership and team-building skills, with a track record of developing managers, not only individual contributors. Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment with a bias toward ownership and action. Nice to Have Experience in email security, cybersecurity, or enterprise infrastructure software. Familiarity with API-based SaaS solutions and cloud-native architectures. description: Headquarters: Philippines - remote At Mixmax, we're building the future of how revenue teams work: smarter, faster, and more human. We're hiring a Billing Support Analyst in the Philippines to join our small but mighty team as one of the go-to contributors and resources for how our customers are billed. You'll resolve billing questions from start to finish, dig into the technical issues that sit underneath them, and keep our Stripe records accurate to the cent. It's part customer support, part billing operations, and part detective work. This role reports directly to our Billing Team Lead, who reports into Head of Customer Experience. You'll work closely with Customer Support, Customer Success, Sales and Engineering across global time zones (NAMER, LATAM, EU), and you'll help shape how we use AI and automation to make billing faster and more accurate for customers. If you check that an invoice's line items add up to its total before you read the customer's email, keep reading. Outcomes In your first 3 months Learn Mixmax's plans, pricing, billing policies and Stripe setup well enough to resolve standard billing tickets on your own. Own a share of the billing queue in Intercom (refunds, invoice questions, plan and seat changes, cancellations) with accurate, on-time responses. Troubleshoot the technical side of billing tickets, such as seat assignment, workspace access and plan-status issues, before escalating. Take over daily past-due invoice follow-up and payment-failure handling. Become a reliable backup for the Billing Team Lead, so billing keeps moving when anyone is out. Use AI tools day to day to summarize ticket history, draft replies and check your work, with every number verified by hand, and find new efficiencies for the team. In your first 6 months Handle complex cases on your own: invoice disputes, proration questions, credits, and billing setup for sales-led contracts. Run recurring reconciliations between Stripe, Salesforce and our product data, and flag mismatches before customers notice them. Write and update billing macros, help-center articles and internal process docs Help test and roll out billing automation, including AI-assisted ticket handling, and define which billing actions should stay with a human. Contribute at least one reusable AI or automation workflow to the team, such as an invoice-dispute triage prompt or a reconciliation checklist. What you'll own Accurate, timely resolution of customer billing inquiries from first reply to close. Stripe account hygiene: invoices, subscriptions, credits, refunds and payment issues. Past-due invoice collection and failed-payment follow-up. Billing accuracy checks and reconciliations across our systems. Clear documentation of billing processes, so knowledge doesn't live in one person's head What you'll be doing Answer billing questions in our support queue, explaining charges, proration and plan changes in plain language Diagnose the technical issues behind billing tickets, like a seat that is billed but not in use or a user stuck on the wrong plan, and work with Support and Engineering to fix them Prepare, correct and send invoices; process refunds, credits and cancellations within policy Spot patterns in billing tickets and turn them into fixes, process changes or product feedback Use AI and automation to work faster, while knowing where accuracy, privacy and customer trust require a human Take on ad-hoc analysis and projects that keep billing records correct What we're looking for 3+ years of combined experience in technical customer support and billing support (invoicing, payments, refunds, collections). You need hands-on experience in both. Experience at a technology or SaaS company Hands-on experience with Stripe and/or accounting and billing software (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero, Chargebee, Zuora, NetSuite) You are very strong with numbers. Proration, percentages, discounts and reconciliations come easily to you, and you check your math without being asked. You are meticulous. You catch the wrong date, the duplicate line and the typo in an email domain. Working knowledge of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or AI features in support tools). You can explain how you use them, how you check their output, and what you won't put into them. Fluent written and spoken English. You can explain a complicated invoice to a frustrated customer clearly and kindly. Based in the Philippines, with a reliable home setup and a schedule that overlaps North American business hours (we'll agree on it together). Comfortable in a remote, fast-moving organization where processes are still being built and refined. Nice to have Experience with Intercom, Zendesk or a similar support platform, and with Salesforce Background in accounting, finance or bookkeeping Experience with subscription or usage-bas

Connect you with experienced Account Executives, Sales leaders, SOC analysts, Detection & Response, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Service Delivery teams. Give you the autonomy to solve difficult customer problems creatively while maintaining the integrity to be clear about what Expel can and cannot do. Deliver technical service demonstrations and tell a compelling story about how Expel creates security value, adapting your approach based on whether you're speaking with practitioners, executives, or somewhere in between. Act as a trusted technical advisor who can ask difficult questions, challenge assumptions, navigate technical objections, and tell a prospect or salesperson "no" when that's the right answer. Partner closely with Account Executives and regional Sales leadership on opportunity strategy, technical discovery, competitive positioning, RFPs/RFIs, and complex customer requirements. title: Scaled Customer Success Manager
description: Headquarters: California URL: https://www.dropbox.com/ Role Description As a Scaled Customer Success Manager at Dropbox, you will drive adoption, value realization, and renewal readiness across a portfolio of mid-market and small business managed customers. You will use customer and product signals to identify where engagement can have the greatest impact, then deliver timely, relevant experiences through targeted campaigns, group programs, digital touchpoints, and selective personalized outreach. You will play a central role in connecting our Programmatic and Digital Customer Success team with the Renewals Desk for scaled segment accounts. You will ensure customer health, sentiment, risk, and adoption signals translate into clear renewal-readiness actions, while identifying and qualifying customer-backed growth opportunities as Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) for handoff to Sales. Within the scaled portfolio, you will provide more focused engagement for a priority group of customers and translate customer health, retention, renewal, and growth signals into regular executive-level updates that support forecasting and business decisions. You will also own shared inbound customer channels, ensuring questions and requests are triaged, resolved, or routed to the right partner with clear follow-through. The successful candidate is a customer-focused operator who is equally comfortable analyzing a portfolio, building repeatable engagement programs, writing clear customer communications, and speaking directly with customers to understand their experience. You will bring recent experience managing or materially influencing customer renewals, including the ability to interpret retention metrics, identify churn and contraction risk, execute save plays, and surface customer-backed growth levers. You will help Dropbox scale Customer Success while retaining the judgment, curiosity, and customer voice that come from real customer conversations. Responsibilities Own adoption, customer health, and renewal readiness across a scaled customer portfolio, using lifecycle, product usage, engagement, sentiment, and retention signals to prioritize action and improve renewal outcomes. Provide focused engagement for a priority group of customers, partnering closely with Renewal Managers and other account stakeholders to coordinate retention and growth actions and deliver regular executive-level portfolio and forecast updates for top accounts in the scaled portfolio. Design and execute targeted campaigns and scaled touchpoints that help customers adopt key capabilities, realize value, prepare for renewal, and address common risks at the right moments in their journey. Serve as the coordination point between Programmatic and Digital Customer Success and the Renewals Desk, ensuring timely handoffs, shared visibility, clear ownership, and coordinated save plays for customers with renewal-readiness gaps or identified churn and contraction risk. Own and manage shared inbound customer email channels, triaging questions and requests, coordinating timely responses, and ensuring issues are resolved or routed to the appropriate partner with clear follow-through. Use data to segment customers, identify patterns, test engagement strategies, measure impact, and continuously improve playbooks, content, workflows, and automation. Engage customers directly when a focused 1:1 conversation is needed to validate a signal, understand sentiment, address risk, gather product feedback, or capture a representative customer example. Synthesize customer voice across the portfolio and share actionable insights with Product, Marketing, Sales, Support, and Customer Experience partners to improve the product and customer journey. Partner cross-functionally to operationalize repeatable customer programs, resolve gaps in the customer experience, and identify customer-backed growth levers such as broader adoption, new use cases, license utilization, or additional product fit. Qualify relevant opportunities as Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) and route them to Sales with clear customer context and supporting signals. Requirements 4+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Account Management, Digital Customer Success, lifecycle programs, or a comparable post-sale customer role. Recent experience directly managing or materially influencing customer renewals across a book of business, with measurable examples of save plays, churn or contraction mitigation, and retention outcomes. Demonstrated success managing customer outcomes across a broad or high-volume portfolio through a combination of one-to-many programs and targeted 1:1 engagement. Strong analytical judgment and fluency in SaaS retention metrics, including renewal rate, gross revenue retention, net revenue retention, churn, contraction, and expansion, with experience using those measures alongside customer signals to identify risk and growth levers. title: Senior 3D Designer
description: Headquarters: San Francisco, CA URL: http://bit.ly/3kLhMdk About Contra Labs Contra Labs sits at the intersection of human creativity and AI. We partner with leading AI labs and product companies to improve their tools across design, video, development, and beyond. Our research is grounded in how top creatives actually work, studying the patterns behind what gets created, what gets chosen, and what resonates. We believe human input will always be at the center of net new creation, and our mission is to help shape technology so human creativity can be amplified to create what today is unimaginable. By joining the Contra Labs network you gain access to paid projects with some of the most innovative companies building the next generation of creative and AI-powered tools. How It Works This is an application to join the network and be eligible for roles as they arise. Projects are staffed on an as-needed basis, typically 5 to 10 hours at a time, though some may extend into longer engagements. In unique cases, we may have full-time roles available as well. When a project matches your skill set, we'll reach out with details and timeline. To Join the Network Portfolio review - We'll assess your Contra profile and portfolio for strength in content design, with a focus on ad creative and performance-driven visual content. Record a 30 second intro video - Share a quick 30 second introduction so we can get to know you. Complete profile - Once you’ve applied, we recommend completing your profile for better job matches and setting up your wallet so you can get paid when a job comes through. What You May Work On Evaluate AI-generated 3D scenes, interactive environments, simulations, and spatial experiences for visual and technical quality Provide clear, structured feedback on scene composition, lighting, materials, physical dynamics, asset integration, interaction, and overall visual coherence Help define quality benchmarks and evaluation criteria for what great AI-generated 3D experiences should look and feel like Identify common failure modes in AI-generated 3D work, from broken physics and interactions to poor spatial composition or inconsistent visual feedback Create reference examples, prototypes, or "golden" outputs that demonstrate best-in-class 3D execution Contribute to research exploring how AI models can better understand and generate interactive 3D experiences What We're Looking For Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality 3D design, interactive environments, or spatial experiences Strong understanding of 3D composition, lighting, materials, animation, and visual coherence Ability to articulate creative and technical feedback clearly and constructively Strong 3D design instincts and awareness of contemporary visual culture, 3D trends, and emerging digital aesthetics Comfort working in fast-paced, experimental environments (experience with AI, 3D tools, or creative technology is a plus) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/contra-senior-3d-designer
